title: Arafat-er portfolio: design world choose koro (round 2)
question: Notun roll e eshechhe 'Ludo Board'. Eta rakho, ekta alternate nao, ba abar re-roll koro.

options.label: Ludo Board
options.lineage: The cardboard Ludo board every Bangladeshi childhood played on
options.thesis: Roll the dice and your token walks to a project: four home yards, four shipped apps, the centre triangle is 'let's talk'.
options.viewport: A big Ludo board as hero: Rivo red yard, Meal Bazar green, Tong yellow, Mentora blue; your name across the centre; a die you can click to roll.
options.risk: Must keep a plain project list beside the board so recruiters never have to play to read.

options.label: Data Portrait
options.lineage: W.E.B. Du Bois 1900 hand-inked data portraits
options.thesis: Your GitHub year, stack and projects drawn as bold hand-inked spirals and bars.
options.viewport: A crimson spiral of 797 contributions beside bars of languages, captions in hand lettering.
options.risk: Ground is cream; needs the saturated colors to carry it.
options.case: Fuses well: real data you have, and it shows backend/data depth with a strong personality.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Your name built cell by cell on a visible grid, like code assembling a system.
options.viewport: Giant ARAFAT assembled from grid cells that fill in on load; projects sit in the same grid.
options.risk: Clever and bold, but cooler and less 'friendly' than Josh.
options.case: Fuses fairly: strong identity, but less warm.

options.label: Scoreboard
options.lineage: Seven-segment clocks, scoreboards and price totems
options.thesis: Your stats as a glowing scoreboard: repos, commits, apps shipped, all in LED digits.
options.viewport: A scoreboard header flipping digits for 797 commits and 4 apps, project list below.
options.risk: Dark and neon, close to the generic dev look you rejected.
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful moment but drifts toward the dark-dev cliché.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean developer portfolio done at full craft: hero, projects grid, about, contact.
canonCard.viewport: Name and role headline, a project card grid, then about and contact.
canonCard.risk: Safe and familiar; this is the genre you called generic.
